subject: Oceanography
title: Gas Hydrates
description: A quick, practical guide to Gas Hydrates.

hook.text: Beneath the cold deep seafloor lies 'fire ice'—methane trapped inside frozen water crystals.

buildup.text: Gas hydrates form when methane meets cold temperatures and high pressures in ocean sediments.

discovery.text: Global hydrate deposits may contain more carbon than all other fossil fuels combined.

twist.text: If ocean warming destabilizes hydrates, massive methane release could accelerate climate change.

climax.text: Japan and China are testing extraction methods—but making it economical remains a challenge.

punchline.text: Ice that burns—the ocean's most paradoxical fuel.

quiz.question: What are gas hydrates?
options: Methane trapped inside ice crystals on the seafloor
